heavy_blow.title: Heavy Blow
heavy_blow.description: Unlocks Heavy Blow (15 mana, 5 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
heavy_blow.extra_description: Cursed Fate's melee art: punch very hard. No weapon needed.

precise_roll.title: Precise Roll
precise_roll.description: Teaches Precise Roll, an Epic Fight Dodge skill: a faster, further and cheaper roll. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

inner_growth.title: Inner Growth
inner_growth.description: Teaches Inner Growth, an Epic Fight Passive skill: regenerate 2 innate power every second. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

shooting_style.title: Shooting Style
shooting_style.description: Teaches Shooting Style, an Epic Fight Identity skill: with an empty hand, hold sneak while attacking to kick (a 3-kick combo). Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

uppercut.title: Uppercut
uppercut.description: Unlocks Uppercut (15 mana, 9 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
uppercut.extra_description: Cursed Fate's melee art: an uppercut that throws targets into the air.

unarmed_parry.title: Empty-Hand Deflection
unarmed_parry.description: Your guard (Parry - Absolute Deflection, Guard or Parrying) can be raised with bare hands, claws or a glove
unarmed_parry.extra_description: Every class has these guards, but only with a weapon; the Monk guards and parries with bare hands.

barrage.title: Barrage
barrage.description: Unlocks Barrage (20 mana, 8 s cooldown) on the ability wheel (hold)
barrage.extra_description: Cursed Fate's melee art: hold to throw a flurry of punches.

heal2.title: Instant Heal II
heal2.description: Teaches Instant Heal II, an Epic Fight Passive skill: a perfect dodge or a perfect parry instantly restores some health. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

follow_up_punch.title: Follow Up Punch
follow_up_punch.description: Unlocks Follow Up Punch (20 mana, 15 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
follow_up_punch.extra_description: Cursed Fate's melee art: teleport behind the last creature you hit.

meditation.title: Meditation
meditation.description: Teaches Meditation, an Epic Fight Passive skill: sneak still for 2 s to meditate; the longer you meditate, the longer the buff (stage 1: +40% damage; stage 2: +30% attack speed and Speed I; stage 3: 50% less damage taken and Regeneration I). Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

heart_shield.title: Heart Shield
heart_shield.description: Teaches Heart Shield, an Epic Fight Passive skill: a 20-point shield that recovers while you take no action. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

knockout.title: Knockout
knockout.description: Unlocks Knockout (25 mana, 20 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
knockout.extra_description: A straight punch at the creature in reach: 1.5x damage, and Blackout (its magic is suppressed) for 6 s.

mindset.title: Mindset
mindset.description: Teaches Mindset, an Epic Fight Passive skill: above 80% health, deal 30% more damage and take 20% less. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

leaping_crush.title: Leaping Crush
leaping_crush.description: Unlocks Leaping Crush (30 mana, 12 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
leaping_crush.extra_description: Cursed Fate's Heavenly Restriction art: leap high and crash down on your foes. No weapon needed.

haste.title: Haste
haste.description: Unlocks Haste (Level 2) (36 mana, 120 s cooldown) on the ability wheel. Hold the Ponder key (W) here to preview it

focus.title: Focus
focus.description: Unlocks Focus (30 mana, 30 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
focus.extra_description: Your next strike within 10 s (a punch, a kick or one of your arts) is a guaranteed Black Flash: 2.5x damage and a short stun.
